title: Intake Manifold Tuning Valve Control Circuit/Open Bank 1
plain: The computer found a problem in the circuit for the valve inside the intake manifold that changes how air flows to the engine at different speeds.
symptoms: Slight loss of power or hesitation at some engine speeds
Rattle from the intake if the valve has broken

causes.name: Faulty intake manifold tuning valve actuator or solenoid
Damaged wiring or corroded connector at the actuator

checks: Inspect the actuator connector and wiring
Check the fuse that powers the actuator
Command the valve with a scan tool and watch whether it moves
fix: Usually a new tuning valve actuator or a wiring repair; some engines need a new intake manifold if the valve is built in.

cost.job: Replace intake manifold tuning valve actuator

drive: It usually doesn't change how the car drives; book a repair; you may notice slightly less power. If you hear a rattle from the intake, get it checked sooner, since broken valve pieces can be drawn into the engine.
test_first: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move, check the fuse, wiring and connector, and inspect for carbon or broken parts before replacing the actuator.

title: Intake Manifold Tuning Valve Control Circuit Low Bank 1
plain: The computer sees lower voltage than expected in the circuit that controls the intake manifold tuning valve, often from a wire shorted to ground. This part changes how air flows inside the intake manifold to improve power at different engine speeds.
symptoms: Slight loss of power or hesitation at some engine speeds
checks: Inspect the intake manifold tuning valve wiring and connector for damage or corrosion
Check related fuses and relays
Test the intake manifold tuning valve with a meter or scan tool and compare with spec
fix: Usually a new tuning valve actuator or a wiring repair; some engines need a new intake manifold if the valve is built in.

title: PCM/ECM/TCM Internal Temperature Sensor Circuit
plain: A control computer has a temperature sensor inside it to protect itself from overheating, and that sensor has a circuit problem.
symptoms: Usually no change in how the car drives

causes.name: Low voltage or poor power and ground at the computer
Computer software that needs an update

checks: Test the battery and computer power and ground circuits
Check for software updates or service bulletins
fix: Fix any power or ground problem first; otherwise the computer may need reprogramming or replacement.

title: Cylinder 1 Glow Plug Control Circuit Low
plain: The computer sees lower voltage than expected in the glow plug control circuit for cylinder 1. Glow plugs heat the cylinders so a diesel engine starts easily in cold weather.
symptoms: Rough running or white smoke right after a cold start

causes.name: Glow plug wire shorted to ground

checks: Measure the cylinder 1 glow plug resistance
Inspect the glow plug wire and connector
fix: Usually a new glow plug or a wiring repair; the control module if the plug and wiring test good.

title: Glow Plug Module Control Circuit
plain: The computer found a problem in the circuit it uses to command the glow plug control module. Glow plugs heat the cylinders so a diesel engine starts easily in cold weather.
symptoms: Rough running or white smoke right after a cold start

causes.name: Damaged wiring or corroded connector between the computer and module

checks: Check fuses and relays for the glow plug system
Inspect the module connector and wiring
Test the module command signal with a scan tool
fix: Usually a new glow plug control module or a wiring repair.
